examples.ar: التَّارِيخُ يُسَجِّلُ مَآثِرَ الرُّوَّادِ بِكَلِمَاتٍ مِنْ ذَهَبٍ.
examples.en: History records the pioneers' achievements in words of gold.

examples.ar: مَا هُوَ تَارِيخُ عِيدِ الجَلَاءِ فِي وَطَنِكَ؟
examples.en: What is the date of the Evacuation Day in your country?
And take provisions, but indeed, the best provision is piety.

examples.ar: الْتَّقْوَى صِلَةٌ رُوحِيَّةٌ بَيْنَ العَبْدِ وَخَالِقِهِ.
examples.en: Piety is a spiritual link between the servant and his Creator.

examples.ar: إِلَّا أَنْ تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً عَنْ تَرَاضٍ مِنْكُمْ.
examples.en: Except that it be a trade conducted by mutual consent among you.

examples.ar: نَالَ الطَّالِبُ كَأْسَ التَّفَوُّقِ الأَكَادِيمِيِّ لِهَذَا العَامِ.
examples.en: The student received the academic excellence cup for this year.
And cooperate in righteousness and piety.

examples.ar: الْتَّعْلِيمُ حَقٌّ أَسَاسِيٌّ لِكُلِّ طِفْلٍ فِي المَعْمُورَةِ.
examples.en: Education is a fundamental right for every child in the world.

examples.ar: التَّسَامُحُ رِسَالَةُ الحَضَارَاتِ الرَّاقِيَةِ لِبِنَاءِ السَّلَامِ.
examples.en: Tolerance is the message of refined civilizations to build peace.

examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُحِبُّ التَّوَّابِينَ وَيُحِبُّ الْمُتَطَهِّرِينَ.
examples.en: Indeed, God loves those who are constantly repentant and loves those who purify themselves.
